evidence.title: Vorssaint — The modular Swiss Army knife for macOS
GitHub - vorssaint/vorssaint-utils: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.

name: Vorssaint
summary: Free, open-source macOS menu bar app bundling window, clipboard, sound and display utilities as installable modules.
description: A modular macOS menu bar toolkit: install only the features you use and remove the rest, from window management, app switcher and Dock previews to clipboard history, text snippets, a per-app volume mixer, keep-awake, a system monitor and a Dynamic Island. Local-first with no account, subscription or telemetry; distributed as a Homebrew cask for Apple silicon on macOS 14+.
contains: modular features: windows and Dock, keyboard and mouse, clipboard, sound, display, tools, system monitor
install with brew install --cask vorssaint; macOS 14+ on Apple silicon
localized in 8 languages (en, pt-br, es, de, fr, it, ja, zh-hans)
one menu bar icon replaces a stack of single-purpose Mac apps
